g.text: The apparent winner depends on the operating policy
Same 64 exposed development images, fixed outputs above score 0.25 and unit false-positive/miss penalties.
These are retrospective proxy comparisons. Thresholds are not calibrated probabilities or validated deployment choices.
Retrospective minimum nominal loss: YOLO11n 207; YOLO26n 210. Every attained cell and tie is retained.
All 515 common-threshold cells with any remaining detections have opposing one-edit-per-image worlds.
